title: Mastercard's verification checklist for signed agent requests
caption: The nine steps of the Level 1 guide's checklist in Mastercard's order, with the three timestamp steps drawn as one check: timestamps and the nonce come before the key lookup, and the signature window may be at most 8 minutes. A request without a scheme tag (Agent-pay-auth, agent-browser-auth or agent-payer-auth) falls back to the ordinary bot policy; every other failure blocks it. Cloudflare lists the same kinds of checks at its edge.
alt: Flowchart. Does the request carry Signature-Input with a scheme tag? If no, apply the non-agent bot policy. If yes, are all required fields present, including @authority and @path? Is created in the past and expires in the future, at most 8 minutes apart? Was the nonce not seen in the last 8 minutes (if it was, block as a replay)? Is the key for keyid found in the directory? Does the signature verify? Any no blocks the request. If all pass, record the nonce with its expiry and treat the request as a trusted agent.
